yt_description:
Excel or Stackby? Excel is brilliant for analysis. Running your business on one shared file is another story: locked files, broken formulas and no apps or automations.

We compared Excel M365 + Copilot with Stackby Business on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI field agents.

Excel M365 + Copilot: $846 a year ($23.50/user/mo).
Stackby Business: $299 a year for 3 users.
That's 65% less.

Feature by feature
• Relational database — Excel: flat sheets & VLOOKUPs · Stackby: linked records, lookups, rollups
• Data you can trust — Excel: anyone can overwrite a cell · Stackby: typed fields & permissions
• Apps & portals — Excel: share the file · Stackby: interfaces & client portals
• Automations — Excel: VBA or separate tools · Stackby: 25,000 runs / month
• Live data from your apps — Excel: exports & manual refresh · Stackby: API columns + sync connectors
• AI — Excel: Copilot add-on · Stackby: AI field agents included

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs/month, interfaces)
• Business: $299/year (50,000 records, 25,000 runs/month, interfaces, sync connectors)
• Pro: $449/year (100,000 records, 100,000 runs/month, interfaces with custom domain, enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup

Prices are public list prices at the time of recording, billed annually. Check each vendor's pricing page for current pricing.
